trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`), and verification shows the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to ensure no duplicate incident was created; the retry succeeded and paged on-call.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release.
